::: {.callout-note}
Written with the clinical study report, after the database lock (tag `dblock-201`). The study
was then unblinded on the reviewer's authorisation (`docs/unblind/unblind-201.yml`, ADR 0032).
The counts here are of the locked data and do not depend on the arms. The structure follows the PHUSE ADRG template, as the guide of FJF-2026-301
(`studies/301/adrg.qmd`), which this guide follows wherever the two studies agree. The data are
simulated and the sponsor is fictional.
:::

## 1. Introduction

The package holds the ADaM datasets of FJF-2026-201: SAS transport v5 files with Parquet
copies, described by `define.xml` (Define-XML 2.1). Standards: ADaMIG 1.3, CDISC ADaM
terminology 2024-03-29. The datasets are made from the SDTM package by the ADaM programs of
FJF-2026-301 (ADR 0030), with this study's specification (`docs/specs/adam-201.yml`), and
analysed as the frozen SAP says (tag `sap-201-v1.0`). The outputs specification
(`docs/sap/fjf-2026-201-outputs.yml`) links each table and figure to the variables it uses.

## 2. Protocol description

See the cSDRG, section 2. The analysis sets are those of the SAP:

| Set | Flag | Definition | Patients |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| Full analysis | FASFL | Randomised | 475 |
| Safety | SAFFL | Randomised and dosed; by treatment taken | 475 |

ADSL also has PPROTFL (402 patients), derived by the FJF-2026-301 program with the week-12
visit. The SAP of this study defines no per-protocol set, so no analysis or output uses it.

## 3. Analysis considerations

The study day, visit windows, missing-visit records (135 with DTYPE = PHANTOM), baselines,
intercurrent-event flags, treatment-emergent adverse events, worst laboratory values, vital
sign limits, missing severity and the last dose follow the FJF-2026-301 programs and are
described in its guide (section 3). What differs:

- **Primary visit**: week 12. Windows use this study's visits (weeks 2, 4, 8, 12 and the
  follow-up at week 14); HbA1c is measured at weeks 4, 8 and 12, body weight at weeks 8 and 12.
- **Time to rescue** (ADTTE.TTRESC) is censored at the end of study or week 12, whichever
  comes first.
- **Dose-response data**: `analysis_data_201()` takes from ADEFF the HbA1c records of the full
  analysis set at the scheduled post-baseline visits, with their on-treatment and pre-rescue
  flags, and adds the dose of each patient's randomised arm (from the protocol, in mg). The
  SAP's analyses (generalised MCP-Mod, model averaging, all observed values) read these
  records, with the F2 code unchanged.
- **Clinical utility index** (exploratory, SAP X1; ADR 0031): the fitted effect by dose and the
  share of patients with an adverse event leading to discontinuation (ADAE.AEACN =
  DRUG WITHDRAWN), by the dose actually taken (TRT01AN).
- **Partial adverse-event start dates**: 16 imputed (ASTDTF). **Missing severity**: 3 events
  counted as severe (ASEVIMFL).
- **Worst laboratory value**: 17 patients have no chemistry value on treatment after baseline,
  so no worst value.
- **Blinding**: the database is locked and the reviewer authorised the unblinding (ADR 0032).
  The treatment variables (TRT01P, TRT01A, TRTP, TRTA and their numeric codes) are the real
  ones. Before the unblinding the same programs ran on a dummy assignment (ADR 0027).
- **ECG**: as in FJF-2026-301, the ECG is not in the study database, so there is no ECG
  analysis dataset.

## 4. Data conformance

See `studies/201/conformance.md`, section *Conformance of the ADaM*. P21 (ADaM-IG 1.3, FDA)
reports only the items FJF-2026-301 explains (traceability rules not run; no MedDRA codes).
The second programming of FJF-2026-301 (`qc/301/adam_qc.R`), run on this study's SDTM, agrees
with production on every dataset it covers.

## 5. Datasets

| Dataset | Class | Records | Key variables |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| ADSL | Subject level | 475 | analysis sets, treatment dates, intercurrent-event dates, baselines |
| ADEFF | BDS | 3,334 | PARAMCD (HBA1C, WEIGHT), AVISITN, ANL01FL, ANL02FL, CRIT1FL |
| ADTTE | BDS | 950 | TTRESC (FAS), TTHYPO23 (SAF) |
| ADEX | Other | 475 | TRTDURD, TRTDURY, COMPLPCT |
| ADAE | OCCDS | 409 | TRTEMFL, ASTDT, ASTDTF, ASEV |
| ADHYPO | OCCDS | 30 | HYPOLVL, ONTRTFL, PRERESFL |
| ADLB | BDS | 13,452 | BASE, BNRIND, ANRIND, WORSTFL |
| ADVS | BDS | 11,501 | BASE, CHG, PCHG, ANL01FL, CRIT1FL, CRIT2FL |

## 6. Outputs and their programs

Each table and figure is listed in `docs/sap/fjf-2026-201-outputs.yml` with the SAP item it
implements, the ADaM variables it reads and its program (`studies/201/tlf/`). The safety and
patient outputs are the FJF-2026-301 programs with the five arms. A second programming of the
tables (`qc/201/tlf_qc.R`) agrees with production cell by cell. The clinical study report
(`studies/201/csr.qmd`) embeds the outputs the pipeline makes.
